about.headline: About Us
about.body: ANOK is a Kathmandu-born house of fragrance — composing rare, slow-crafted perfumes that hold time, memory and the quiet weight of luxury.
about.bodyExtended: Every fragrance we create begins with a question: what does this moment smell like? We source only the rarest raw materials — Calabrian bergamot, white orchid, Madagascar vanilla and sun-drenched driftwood — and blend them slowly, letting each accord mature before it meets the bottle.
about.brandQuote: Crafted for those who understand that a fragrance is not just a scent — it is a memory, an identity, a quiet statement of who you are.

reasons.title: Artistic Design
reasons.body: Every fragrance is a masterpiece, crafted with precision by world-class perfumers.

reasons.title: Organic Ingredients
reasons.body: Sourced from nature's finest, each note embodies pure sophistication.

reasons.title: Sustainable Elegance
reasons.body: Indulge guilt-free with fragrances designed to honour the planet.

reasons.title: Made in Small Batches
reasons.body: Every bottle is blended in limited quantities, never mass-produced. Quality over volume, always.

featuredProduct.name: ANOK-001
featuredProduct.tagline: Indulge in the bold, sophisticated aroma of ANOK. Encased in a tactile, velvet-matte bottle with rich gold accents, this signature Eau de Parfum balances luminous citrus brightness with warm, earthy woods and velvety vanilla.
featuredProduct.description: Designed for those who command presence without saying a word. ANOK-001 is the first composition to carry our name — opening bright, settling deep, and staying with you long after you have left the room.

top.impression: A bright, invigorating burst of fresh citrus sophistication.

heart.impression: A smooth, elegant floral core with a subtle hint of warm sweetness.

base.impression: A deep, comforting grounding of rich woods and smoky resins.

highlights.title: Long-Lasting Performance
highlights.body: Formulated with high-concentration fragrance oils to endure 8+ hours on skin.

highlights.title: Artisanal Design
highlights.body: A distinctive square matte bottle finished with a gold-embossed emblem and a crystal-clear architectural cap.

highlights.title: Sustainably Sourced
highlights.body: Crafted with responsibly harvested natural oils and cruelty-free ingredients.

specs.label: Bottle Material
specs.value: Heavy-weight glass, matte-touch coating with gold detailing

usage.title: Target Pulse Points
usage.body: Spray directly onto the warm areas of the body — wrists, inner elbows, the base of the neck and behind the ears.

usage.title: Do Not Rub
usage.body: Let the fragrance dry naturally on skin. Rubbing your wrists together breaks down the scent molecules and alters the top notes.

usage.title: Layer on Moisturised Skin
usage.body: Apply onto freshly moisturised skin to lock in the aroma for maximum projection and longevity.

featuredProduct.orderingNote: Orders are arranged directly with us over WhatsApp — we will confirm availability, delivery and payment with you. Every full-size bottle ships with a matching 2 ml trial sample, so you can test the scent before opening the 100 ml.

commitment.headline: A Commitment To Purity
commitment.body: We believe in sustainable luxury. Every bottle of ANOK is crafted with responsibly sourced ingredients, ensuring a lasting impact on you—not on the environment.

pillars.title: Responsibly Sourced
pillars.body: Every raw material is ethically harvested — aged oud, Bulgarian rose, Himalayan botanicals — with full traceability.

pillars.title: Small Batch Crafted
pillars.body: Each fragrance is blended in limited quantities, never mass-produced. Quality over volume, always.

pillars.title: No Synthetic Shortcuts
pillars.body: We use only natural isolates and absolutes. No artificial fixatives, no cheap synthetics hidden in the base.

pillars.title: Low-Impact Packaging
pillars.body: Bottles are reusable, packaging is recycled. Our footprint stays as light as our finest top notes.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal information ANOK collects when you use this website or contact us, how we use it, and the choices you have. We keep it deliberately short, because we collect very little.

sections.heading: What We Collect
sections.body:
We collect only what you give us directly.

When you send us a message through the contact form, we receive your name, email address, chosen subject and the content of your message. When you subscribe to our newsletter, we receive your email address. We do not ask for, store, or process payment card details anywhere on this website.

sections.heading: How We Use It
sections.body:
We use your details for one purpose: to reply to you. Contact form submissions are used to answer your enquiry. Newsletter addresses are used to send occasional updates about ANOK — new releases, restocks and announcements.

We do not sell, rent or trade your information to anyone.

sections.heading: Cookies & Analytics
sections.body: This website does not set advertising or tracking cookies, and does not run third-party analytics or advertising pixels. If that changes, this policy will be updated before the change goes live.

sections.heading: Third Parties
sections.body: Some parts of the site rely on outside services — for example our website host, and WhatsApp if you choose to start a conversation with us through the button on the site. Those services handle your data under their own privacy policies. We share your information with them only to the extent needed to run the site or answer you.

sections.heading: How Long We Keep It
sections.body: We keep enquiry correspondence for as long as needed to deal with your question and any follow-up. Newsletter subscriptions are kept until you unsubscribe, which you can do at any time.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.body: You can ask us at any time to tell you what information we hold about you, to correct it, or to delete it. Write to hello@anok.fragrance and we will act on your request.

sections.heading: Contact Us
sections.body: Questions about this policy can go to hello@anok.fragrance, or by post to ANOK, Maharajgunj Chakrapath, Kathmandu, Nepal. You can also call us on +977 9868 765 432.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These terms cover your use of the ANOK website. By browsing the site you accept them. If you do not agree with them, please do not use the site.

sections.heading: About This Site
sections.body:
This website is operated by ANOK, based at Maharajgunj Chakrapath, Kathmandu, Nepal. It exists to present our fragrance and to let you get in touch with us.

This site is not an online shop. It has no cart and no checkout, and no order can be placed or completed through it. Enquiries and purchases are arranged directly with us by message, phone or WhatsApp.

sections.heading: Product Information & Pricing
sections.body:
We describe our fragrance as accurately as we can, but product photography, notes and descriptions are presented for guidance and are not a guarantee of an exact match. Scent is experienced differently by different people.

Prices shown on this site are indicative and may change without notice. The price confirmed with you directly at the time of purchase is the price that applies.

sections.heading: Availability
sections.body: Our fragrance is produced in small batches. Listing it on this site is not a guarantee that stock is available at any given moment. We will confirm availability when you contact us.

sections.heading: Intellectual Property
sections.body: All content on this site — including the ANOK name, logo, product photography, and written copy — belongs to us and is protected by copyright and trade mark law. You may not copy, reproduce or reuse it commercially without our written permission.

sections.heading: Acceptable Use
sections.body: Please do not attempt to disrupt the site, gain unauthorised access to any part of it, or use the contact form or newsletter to send unsolicited, abusive or unlawful material.

sections.heading: Liability
sections.body: We take care to keep this site accurate and available, but we provide it as it is. We are not liable for losses arising from your use of the site or from reliance on information published on it, to the extent the law allows us to limit that liability.

sections.heading: Changes to These Terms
sections.body: We may update these terms as our business grows — for example if we begin selling online. The version published on this page is the one that applies.

sections.heading: Governing Law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of Nepal, and the courts of Nepal have jurisdiction over any dispute arising from them.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Answers to what we get asked most. If your question is not here, send it to us — we reply to everything.

items.question: How do I buy ANOK-001?
items.answer: There is no online checkout on this site yet. Message us through the contact form or tap the WhatsApp button and we will confirm availability, price and delivery with you directly.

items.question: What does ANOK-001 smell like?
items.answer: It opens on Calabrian bergamot and citrus zest, moves through white orchid and Madagascar vanilla at the heart, and settles on sun-drenched driftwood and amber. Warm and woody rather than sharp — it develops slowly over the first hour on skin.

items.question: What sizes are available?
items.answer: ANOK-001 is offered in 100 ml, 50 ml, 30 ml and 10 ml. The 10 ml is a good way to live with the fragrance before committing to a full bottle.

items.question: How long does it last?
items.answer: Most people find it lasts through a working day. Oud and amber are heavy base notes that hold well, though longevity always varies with skin type, weather and how much you apply.

items.question: Do you deliver outside Kathmandu?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us where you are when you get in touch and we will confirm delivery options and timing for your location.

items.question: Is it suitable for men or for women?
items.answer: Both. We do not split our work into men's and women's fragrance. ANOK-001 is composed to be worn by anyone who likes it.

items.question: Are your ingredients natural?
items.answer: We use responsibly harvested natural oils and cruelty-free ingredients, and avoid artificial fixatives and cheap synthetics. ANOK-001 is crafted in Kathmandu, Nepal.

items.question: How should I store my bottle?
items.answer: Keep it upright, away from direct sunlight and away from heat. A drawer or a closed cupboard is ideal. Stored properly, an unopened bottle keeps for years.

items.question: Will you release more fragrances?
items.answer: Yes. ANOK-001 is the first composition to carry our name, and the numbering is deliberate. Subscribe to the newsletter to hear about the next one first.
